arms.clean: all sampled clean rows, correctly labeled
arms.if540: Isolation Forest on the 540-feature stack representation
arms.if60: Isolation Forest on the 60-feature control representation
arms.oracle: all poison removed and all clean retained; identical to clean
arms.poisoned: all clean rows plus malicious poisons observed as benign
arms.random_cost_matched: fixed random suspect ordering; shortest prefix removing exactly the same number of unmodified suspect rows as its paired sanitizer

endpoints.guardrail: benign false-positive rate on that test set
endpoints.primary: malicious recall on the identity-safe unmodified test set

execution_policy.deviations: report all deviations; do not retune or selectively rerun cells
execution_policy.feature_reuse: A prior UNSW TDA feature cache may be reused only after its input, raw, poison-mask, 60-feature, and 540-feature hashes reproduce. Prior CICIDS feature caches are forbidden.
execution_policy.outcomes_require: matching external OSF registration receipt and registered code commit
execution_policy.parallelism: TDA extraction is sequential because its internal pipelines use all cores; classifier and Isolation Forest internals use eight workers.

external_test.locked_secondary_stress_test: same-family transformed copies of 10 percent of test rows, selected only from truly malicious common-attackable examples
external_test.selection: fixed seeded row-random candidate order; take the first rows whose exact raw-payload SHA-256 is absent from every clean or poisoned training arm
external_test.size: equal to the clean training population

inference.estimand: equal-weight mean over seeds and families
inference.hierarchy: resample five seeds, then attack families within each seed

poisoning.claim_boundary: Byte permutations preserve the byte multiset; network or application functionality is not claimed.

primary_analysis.decision: all four gates are required for an operational-benefit claim
gates: clean minus poisoned recall mean >= 0.02 and CI lower > 0
IF60 minus poisoned recall mean >= 0.01 and CI lower > 0
IF60 minus random-cost-matched recall mean > 0 and CI lower > 0
IF60 minus clean benign-FPR CI upper <= 0.01
primary_analysis.non_rescue: IF540, the 1 percent budget, CICIDS populations, secondary endpoints, and the attacked-test stress test cannot rescue the primary claim.
primary_analysis.recovery_fraction: reported only when clean minus poisoned malicious recall is positive

prospective_status.prior_information: The completed clean-novelty confirmation results are known and motivated this extension; this is not an independent replication.

protocol_correction.issue: The prior binary-label helper recognized UNSW 'normal' but not CICIDS 'BENIGN', so prior CICIDS poison targets were not guaranteed to be malicious.
protocol_correction.locked_fix: After strip/lower normalization, 'normal' and 'benign' map to 0; every other label maps to 1. New CICIDS attacks are generated prospectively and no prior CICIDS attack outcome is reused.

sanitizer.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on detector-training trusted clean only
sanitizer.threshold: higher empirical quantile of calibration-clean anomaly scores

training_partition.filter_scope: suspect batch only; trusted core is never filtered
training_partition.reuse: literal clean rows and exact raw-hash-disjoint 60/20/20 splits
training_partition.suspect_batch: held-out clean (20 percent) plus appended poison
